Message.Name: Login Request Message
Message.Description: Tcp login request for retransmission or snapshot. Packet Type R selects retransmission and L selects snapshot.

Field.Name: Multicast Group Number
Field.Description: Multicast Group Number for the request target

Field.Name: Number of System Reboots
Field.Description: For retransmission set to the number of times the system has been rebooted; for snapshot set to 0

Field.Name: Sequence Number
Field.Description: For retransmission set to the first sequence number for the request; for snapshot set to 0

Field.Name: Requested Message Count
Field.Description: For retransmission set to the number of messages from the first sequence number; for snapshot set to 0

Message.Name: Login Result Message
Message.Description: Tcp login response. Packet Type A indicates accepted and J indicates rejected.

Field.Name: Multicast Group Number
Field.Description: Multicast Group Number for the request target

Field.Name: Result Code
Field.Description: Set to the result code of the login request

Message.Name: Message Response Message
Message.Description: Tcp message response carrying tag data including their packet headers in response to a retransmission or snapshot request.

Field.Name: Data
Field.Description: Variable length payload of FLEX tags including their packet headers

Message.Name: End of Message Message
Message.Description: Tcp end of message marker terminating a retransmission or snapshot session.

Field.Name: Multicast Group Number
Field.Description: Multicast Group Number for the request target

Field.Name: Number of System Reboots
Field.Description: For retransmission set to 0; for snapshot set to the number of times the system has been rebooted

Field.Name: Next Sequence Number
Field.Description: For retransmission set to 0; for snapshot indicates the next multicast transmission sequence number that should be received after capturing the snapshot
